cards.audioText: What factors may have contributed to the ground-handling accident shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能促成图中所示的地面作业事故？

cards.audioText: How can ground-handling accidents involving aircraft be prevented?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何预防涉及航空器的地面作业事故？
cards.referenceText: Prevention depends on trained and authorized staff, clear procedures, serviceable equipment and positive communication before any vehicle or aircraft movement. Marked safety zones, wing walkers, speed control, brake checks, chocks and confirmation that doors, panels and equipment are clear reduce collision risk. Fatigue, poor visibility and time pressure should be managed, and near misses reported so repeated hazards are corrected.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预防措施包括使用经过训练和授权的人员、明确程序、状况良好的设备，以及在任何车辆或飞机移动前进行明确沟通。划定安全区、安排翼尖监护员、控制速度、检查刹车、使用轮挡，并确认舱门和面板已妥善关闭、设备已撤离飞机运动区域，可以降低碰撞风险。还应管理疲劳、低能见度和时间压力，并报告险情，以便纠正反复出现的危险。
